purpose: diagnostic multi-reference surface completion using existing 100 Hz HDR keyframes

source_references.selection: all exact logged 100 Hz source frames within the cached 40 ms interval

geometry.static_labels: reuse actual fixed-camera pixels and depths from observed references
geometry.moving_labels: project source samples by source-body-to-interpolated-target-body SE3, then rasterize same-label continuous triangles
geometry.visibility: per-pixel nearest interpolated depth across moving references and observed static background
geometry.unobserved_or_ambiguous: request full direct render; no spatial inpainting or threshold change

radiometry.temporal_interpolation: log-domain interpolation between bracketing observations of the same frontmost label and depth
radiometry.single_sided_observation: temporally hold nearest actual source sample and report separately

evaluation.full_direct_render_fallback: charged once per requested target frame
evaluation.old_checkpoints: diagnostic only; trained on previous event-generation domain
